steps.en: Install PyTorch and the ImageCaptcha generator; set the charset and length in its settings file
steps.zh: 装好 PyTorch 和 captcha 库，在设置文件里定字符集和位数

steps.en: Run the generator to make auto-labeled synthetic captchas
steps.zh: 运行生成脚本，造出自带标注的合成验证码

steps.en: Writes images into dataset/train/, the answer encoded in each file name
steps.zh: 把图片写进 dataset/train/，答案就编在文件名里

steps.en: Trains a small CNN whose output has one score slice per character position; saves model.pkl
steps.zh: 训练一个小 CNN，输出按字符位置切成若干段打分，存成 model.pkl

steps.en: Run prediction on the images in the predict folder
steps.zh: 对 predict 目录里的图片跑预测

steps.en: Picks the top-scoring character in each slice and prints the 4-character code
steps.zh: 每段取得分最高的字符，拼出 4 位验证码打印出来

value.en: A readable end-to-end baseline: no character segmentation, no hand labeling — the generator labels the data for you
value.zh: 一个读得懂的端到端基线：不切字符、不手工标注，标注由生成器顺带完成
